description: THE HOSTS' OWN LIST of what their guests have asked for on a personal event this connector serves. Call it for "what have our guests asked for", "any dietary requests", "who needs anything". It returns the OPEN requests, newest first, each one as a category, the note the guest wrote, who it is from and when it landed. ONLY THE HOSTS can read it; anybody else gets a refusal you read out as given. WHO IT IS FROM IS A FIRST NAME OR THE WORDS "a guest", and there is no phone number, no email address and no account id on this surface at all, so never offer to contact somebody from this list. Read the notes out as given and do not summarise a need into something the guest did not say. Pass `markHandled` with a request id from a row to mark that one dealt with, which only removes it from this list and does not message anybody. It requires a personal connector token.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event NAME as the hosts spell it.

markHandled.description: OPTIONAL. The `id` of one request, exactly as a row from this same tool gave it. Never construct one. It marks that request handled so it leaves this list; it messages nobody and changes nothing on the event.

name: event_guest_requests
title: Read the guests' requests (hosts only)
